intro: Perfect for modern families, the Oregano dining set saves space while offering style. Its sleek MDF table and cushioned chairs turn everyday meals into moments of comfort and togetherness.

features.title: Sized right for compact homes
features.text: The 4-seater square table fits perfectly in small apartments, giving you a complete dining solution without crowding your space.

features.title: Sturdy MDF top and understructure
features.text: A strong MDF top and base provide daily durability while the cream and brown finish brings a touch of warmth to your interiors.

features.title: Olive chairs with cushioned support
features.text: PU foam cushioning in PU upholstery makes the chairs comfortable for long meals and conversations with family or guests.

features.title: Stylish colour coordination
features.text: The cream table finish pairs seamlessly with matt brown chair upholstery, creating a modern and cohesive look for your dining area.

features.title: Durable metal chair frame
features.text: Powder-coated metal legs add strength and stability to the chairs, ensuring lasting comfort and everyday reliability.

features.title: Sleek design with modern appeal
features.text: Clean lines and a minimalist profile let the set blend into both traditional and contemporary homes with ease.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
